correctness.rationale: PASS: For t=b+u, b integer and 0<=u<1, crossing index is unchanged and R_t=R_b-u; only integer boundaries need maximizing. For integer 0<=b<m, conditioning on first long jump after j unit jumps gives e_b=sum_{j=0}^b p q^j(m+j-b)+q^{b+1}=m-b+q/p-q^{b+1}(m+q/p). Consecutive difference e_b-e_{b-1}=mu q^b-1, mu=q+pm, forces a unique or adjacent tied maximum at k=floor(log mu/(-log q)). Derivative of mu q^{m-1} in p proves k<=m-2. For b>=m, e_b=q e_{b-1}+p e_{b-m}; convexity prevents any later higher or tied maximum because the initial maximizers lie at one point or adjacent positions. Rare-long-jump scaling p=lambda/m gives (1/m)sup e_b ->1-log(1+lambda)/lambda, strictly less than lambda/(1+lambda) by (1+lambda)log(1+lambda)>lambda. Independent rational recurrence stress tests checked 715 parameter cases; infinite result is from induction.
